records.title: Axie Infinity begins its blockchain-game economy
records.summary: Axie began its Origin Axie presale in February, opened its marketplace in March and launched early battle systems later in 2018.
records.significance: Axie was an early attempt to combine tradable NFTs, breeding and a game economy years before play-to-earn exploded.

records.title: Steem demonstrates stake-weighted witness governance
records.summary: Steem's delegated-proof-of-stake governance used stake-weighted voting to elect 21 block-producing witnesses, with community reporting in 2018 tracking participation in witness voting.
records.significance: Steem was an early large-scale experiment in token-holder governance and elected block producers, foreshadowing later disputes over stake concentration and delegated governance.

sources.title: Steem Developer Docs — witness voting and proxies

records.title: BitConnect collapses
records.summary: BitConnect announced the immediate closure of its lending operation and said its exchange would close days later.
records.significance: The implosion became one of crypto's most notorious fraud-era collapses.

records.title: ERC-721 NFT standard is created
records.summary: EIP-721 defined a standard interface for non-fungible tokens on Ethereum.
records.significance: ERC-721 standardized NFT interoperability across wallets, marketplaces and applications.

records.title: Coincheck loses 526 million NEM
records.summary: Coincheck suffered unauthorized transfers of 526,300,010 XEM after attackers obtained NEM private keys.
records.significance: The theft was one of the largest exchange hacks by contemporaneous dollar value and drove Japanese regulatory scrutiny.

records.title: Lightning Labs releases first mainnet beta
records.summary: Lightning Labs released lnd 0.4-beta, its first implementation designated for Bitcoin mainnet use.
records.significance: It marked Lightning's transition from research/test networks toward real-money Bitcoin payment infrastructure.

records.title: India's central bank restricts crypto banking services
records.summary: The RBI directed regulated financial institutions not to provide services dealing with virtual currencies and to exit existing relationships.
records.significance: The measure sharply constrained India's crypto industry until the Supreme Court set it aside in 2020.

records.title: EOS mainnet becomes operational
records.summary: EOS became operational after token holders elected enough block producers to activate the chain.
records.significance: EOS combined record-scale fundraising with delegated proof-of-stake governance and became a major smart-contract competitor.

records.title: Hinman speech distinguishes decentralized Bitcoin/Ether from many token offerings
records.summary: SEC Corporation Finance Director William Hinman said that, based on his understanding, current offers and sales of Bitcoin and Ether did not involve securities transactions.
records.significance: The staff-level speech became one of the era's most influential US regulatory statements about decentralization and token status.

sources.title: SEC — Digital Asset Transactions: When Howey Met Gary

records.notes: Staff-level analysis, not a Commission rule.

records.title: Augur launches decentralized prediction markets
records.summary: Augur's decentralized prediction-market platform launched on Ethereum after years of development.
records.significance: It was one of Ethereum's earliest major applications and a landmark oracle/prediction-market experiment.

records.title: Gemini launches Gemini Dollar
records.summary: Gemini launched GUSD, an Ethereum-based dollar-backed stablecoin.
records.significance: GUSD belonged to the first wave of regulated reserve-backed stablecoins competing with Tether.

records.title: USDC launches
records.summary: Circle and CENTRE launched USD Coin, with Circle as the first commercial issuer.
records.significance: USDC became one of crypto's most important regulated dollar stablecoins across exchanges, DeFi and payments.

records.title: Monero activates Bulletproofs
records.summary: Monero's network upgrade enabled Bulletproofs, sharply reducing confidential transaction sizes.
records.significance: Bulletproofs materially improved the practicality and scalability of Monero's privacy model.

records.title: Zcash Sapling upgrade activates
records.summary: Sapling activated at block 419,200 and greatly reduced the computing requirements of shielded transactions.
records.significance: Sapling made privacy-preserving Zcash transactions much more practical for ordinary wallets and mobile devices.

records.title: Uniswap launches
records.summary: Hayden Adams publicly announced and deployed Uniswap on Ethereum mainnet.
records.significance: Its constant-product automated market maker became foundational DeFi infrastructure.

sources.title: Uniswap — A Short History of Uniswap

records.title: Bitcoin Cash hash war splits BCH and Bitcoin SV
records.summary: A contentious Bitcoin Cash hard fork split the network into rival Bitcoin ABC/BCH and Bitcoin SV implementations.
records.significance: The hash war showed how mining power, personalities and incompatible protocol visions could fracture an already forked chain.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Bitcoin Cash splits in two

records.title: Ohio opens Bitcoin option for selected business tax payments
records.summary: Ohio's Treasurer began accepting Bitcoin for selected business-tax payments through OhioCrypto.com.
records.significance: It was a notable US state-government experiment with Bitcoin as a payment rail for taxes.

sources.title: Ohio Department of Taxation — Cryptocurrency business tax payments
